name: gsp-motion-cli
description: Deterministic dependency-driven GSP geometry animation CLI

scripts.test: node --test test.cjs test-cli.cjs test-effects.cjs test-visibility.cjs test-label-arc.cjs
scripts.demo: node cli.cjs animate examples/demo1_triangle_circumcircle.gsp --point A --from -30 --to 30 --concyclic A,B,C --fixed 1 --out output --frames --mp4
scripts.demo:line: node cli.cjs animate examples/demo1_triangle_line.gsp --point A --from -50 --to 50 --fixed B,C --out output-line --frames --mp4
